notes.subject: עשתתרות
notes.rationale: 'increase of flock' vs possible echo of Ashtoreth (fertility goddess) — same consonants עשתרות.

notes.subject: פרי בטנך
notes.rationale: 'fruit of your belly' → 'ol pikinini bilong bel bilong yu' per D4: זרע/fruit as pikinini.

notes.subject: פרי אדמתך
notes.rationale: 'fruit of your soil' → 'ol kaikai bilong graun', garden-fruit reading per D4 gloss for plant seed.

notes.subject: blessing inventory
notes.rationale: Verse lists and counts the spheres of blessing: womb, soil, herd, flock — a structured catalogue.

translation: Blessed ol pikinini bilong bel bilong yu, na ol kaikai bilong graun bilong yu, na ol pikinini bilong ol animal bilong lukautim bilong yu — ol pikinini bilong ol bulmakau bilong yu, na ol pikinini bilong ol sipsip na meme bilong yu.

tokens.gloss: ol animal bilong lukautim bilong yu
ol sipsip na meme bilong yu
